description: Write a bus purchase proposal for a church, school, camp or senior living board: the need, the bus, why not a 15-passenger van, the driver and license plan, a five-year cost table from the buyer's own figures, funding to ask about, an inspection plan and a draft motion with a not-to-exceed amount. Returns Markdown. Invents no costs: blank figures are left out.

listing_url.description: A commercialbuses.com listing URL, if the bus is listed here.

not_to_exceed_usd.description: The most the board authorizes. Defaults to the price.

signer.description: Name and title of who signs.

name: draft_board_proposal
